arguments.title: VideoMAE: Masked Autoencoders are Data-Efficient Learners for Self-Supervised Video Pre-Training
key_claims: High-ratio tube masking makes reconstruction less susceptible to copying redundant neighboring frames. The paper emphasizes data quality/domain shift. This motivates order-destroying controls and temporal leakage checks, not a claim that masking inherently preserves color or predicts music-driven light. We defer training this model and use a small released frozen temporal candidate only in a preregistered qualification stage; verify the actual checkpoint terms and runtime before any later acquisition.
